definitions.explanation: The quality or state of being quiet and still. Derived from the adjective {静|しず}か by adding the suffix -さ. Often used to describe peaceful atmospheres in nature, at night, or in contemplative settings.

examples.japanese: {森|もり}の{静|しず}けさに{包|つつ}まれる。
examples.english: Be enveloped in the stillness of the forest.

examples.japanese: {夜|よる}の{静|しず}けさの{中|なか}で、{虫|むし}の{声|こえ}だけが{聞|き}こえた。
examples.english: In the quietness of the night, only the sound of insects could be heard.

examples.japanese: {試験|しけん}{中|ちゅう}の{教室|きょうしつ}には、ペンの{音|おと}しか{聞|き}こえない{静|しず}けさが{漂|ただよ}っていた。
examples.english: A quietness in which only the sound of pens could be heard hung over the classroom during the exam.

notes:
FORMATION:
{静|しず}けさ is formed from the na-adjective {静|しず}か + the nominalizing suffix さ. This is a productive pattern: {暖|あたた}か → {暖|あたた}かさ, {豊|ゆた}か → {豊|ゆた}かさ.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {静|しず}けさに{包|つつ}まれる (to be enveloped in stillness)
- {静|しず}けさが{漂|ただよ}う (silence hangs in the air)
- {静|しず}けさを{破|やぶ}る (to break the silence)
- {静|しず}けさを{楽|たの}しむ (to enjoy the quiet)
- {不気味|ぶきみ}な{静|しず}けさ (an eerie silence)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {静|しず}けさ: quietness, stillness (atmospheric quality)
- {沈黙|ちんもく}: silence (deliberate absence of speech)
- {静寂|せいじゃく}: deep silence (more literary/formal)
